children.label: clustersystem
children.description: A coordination mechanism where humanitarian organizations are grouped into clusters based on their expertise to ensure a coherent and effective response.

children.label: interagencycoordination
children.description: A framework that facilitates collaboration and communication between different humanitarian agencies to avoid duplication of efforts and ensure a comprehensive response.

children.label: cashworkinggroups
children.description: Specialized coordination bodies that focus on the distribution and management of cash-based assistance to affected populations, ensuring efficient and equitable aid delivery.

children.label: localcoordinationforums
children.description: Platforms at the local level where community leaders, local NGOs, and international organizations come together to plan and coordinate humanitarian activities.

children.label: governmentledcoordination
children.description: A coordination structure where the government takes the lead in organizing and managing the humanitarian response, often involving multiple stakeholders and sectors.
